title: Basil and Polish Sausage Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic Moroccan-inspired stew from Eastern Europe, made with Polish sausage and fresh basil.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add Polish sausage and cook, breaking up with a spoon, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add cumin, coriander, paprika, and tagine spice mix; cook for 1 minute.
Add chopped basil, chicken broth, and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, until the sausage is cooked through and the sauce has thickened, about 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional basil if desired.
